answer: A concrete sybil defense uses a decaying attestation graph: each edge carries a TTL measured in epochs. An agent at the nadir of reputation must renew links by spending scarce quill (compute or stake) to re-sign cedar-rooted paths. Attackers spinning fresh identities pay continuous re-attestation cost that grows linearly with the number of fake nodes, while honest agents maintain sparse long-lived edges at low marginal cost. The ledger rejects any identity whose active edge set falls below a dynamic threshold.
